name: evolve-skill
title_zh: 拿真实代码库当考场，给已装技能做迭代升级
tagline_zh: 别在空提示词里调技能了。丢给它一个仓库，它会跑任务、看失败、改指令，直到技能在你自己的代码上真正变强。
tagline_en: Stop tuning skills in the void. Point it at a repo, it runs tasks, reads failures, rewrites instructions—until.
desc_en: Use when asked to evolve, improve, tune, or optimise an installed Claude Code skill against a target codebase, or when given a skill name together with a repo to test it on.
why_zh: 它把「优化技能」从拍脑袋改成闭环：以真实代码库为测试集，用失败反推指令修改，每次迭代都有可验证的进步。
why_en: Turns skill-tuning from guesswork into a closed loop: real repos as test set, failures drive instruction edits, every iteration.
limit_zh: 只针对已安装的 Claude Code 技能做迭代，不负责写新技能；需要你提供可运行的目标仓库和明确任务。
limit_en: Only iterates on installed Claude Code skills, not for writing new ones. Needs a runnable target repo and a concrete task—otherwise it stalls.
title_en: Evolve installed skills against a real codebase
